mandatory_future_stage_a_handoff: For W_COMP, FF4_COMP, SCORE_ONLY_GENERIC_MAX, and SCOPE_MATCHED_GENERIC_MAX, the only persistent actor-visible state is the exact bytes of compile_skill(...).skill_markdown materialized as SKILL.md.
The Stage-A runner must recompute SHA-256 of the materialized SKILL.md and require equality with CompiledState.skill_sha256 before any actor provider I/O.
The actor receives the parent directory only through the standard skill_source / skill_sources interface and must load that exact SKILL.md.
Raw TypedDiagnosis fields, diagnosis JSON, required_repairs enums, arm labels, and hidden experiment metadata are never actor-visible.
No LLM, paraphraser, summarizer, or second free-form renderer may transform deterministic compiler/control output between compile_skill and actor consumption.
All FREE/COMP/generic states still enter the already-frozen universal state-SHA equivalence-class procedure before actor evaluation.
pre_provider_failure_conditions: materialized SKILL.md bytes differ from compile_skill output
materialized SKILL.md SHA differs from CompiledState.skill_sha256
actor skill_source is not the directory containing the SHA-verified SKILL.md
raw typed diagnosis or hidden metadata is exposed to actor
any additional model-based render occurs after compile_skill
state-SHA aliasing is applied before final actor-visible bytes are frozen

atomgit_shadow_rationale.finding: Synthetic V3-V8 shadow panels showed that free-form write serialization can vary, state omissions can propagate under controlled consumption, and raw typed-field interpretation can be actor-dependent; a deterministic schema-aware consumer mapping closed one GLM synthetic interpretation gap.
atomgit_shadow_rationale.why_no_protocol_reopen: Formal Bridge V4-R2 does not expose raw typed fields to the actor: its scientific method is typed diagnosis followed by deterministic canonical Markdown primitive rendering. The addendum therefore binds the future execution handoff to the already-reviewed complete method rather than changing the method, estimand, task split, model, or gate.
